verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs state you can drop a project folder to deploy, which covers upload without Git. They also say new projects stay private until you choose to publish, and the CLI supports deploying directly from a working directory. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the privacy and publish controls work, and independent or hands-on corroboration of drag-and-drop deploys staying private.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy a project by uploading a folder of files directly, with no Git repo required and the new deployment kept private until I choose to publish it

citations.quote: Drop your project folder and deploy in seconds. New projects stay private until you choose to publish.
Deploy directly from your working directory.
